description: This is a FastAPI backend source file that defines the API endpoints for a career pathway navigator. The file includes route handlers for health checks, role and role detail retrieval, progress tracking, graph generation, recommendations, and assessments. It also initializes the database, manages CORS middleware configuration, and imports various models, schemas, and repositories related to roles, skills, progress, and recommendations.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Represents a role entity possibly including related skills, recommendations, and metadata.

classes.name: RoleSkill
classes.description: Represents the association between roles and skills, including required levels and recommendations.

classes.name: Recommendation
classes.description: Model representing recommendations linked to role-skill pairs.

methods.name: None on_startup()
methods.description: Initializes database tables and seeds minimal dataset if needed during app startup.

methods.name: dict health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint returning a 'Healthy' message.

methods.name: List[RoleOut] list_roles(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to list all available roles.

methods.name: RoleDetailOut get_role_detail(role_name: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Fetches detailed information for a specific role by name, including skills and recommendations.

methods.name: List[ProgressOut] get_role_progress(role_name: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Returns progress entries for a particular role.

methods.name: ProgressOut set_progress( role_name: str, skill_name: str = Query(..., min_length=2, max_length=200, description="Skill name"), status: str = Query(..., pattern="^(not_started|working_on|complete)$", description="Progress status"), current_level: int = Query(..., ge=0, le=5, description="Current skill level"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Creates or updates a progress record for a given role and skill.

methods.name: GraphOut get_graph( fromRole: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Current role ID"), toRole: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Target role ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Constructs and returns a role transition graph including nodes, links, and meta-data.

methods.name: List[RecommendationOut] get_recommendations( roleId: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Role ID"), skillId: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Skill ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Returns recommendations for a specified role ID and skill ID.

methods.name: AssessmentOut assess_roles(payload: AssessmentIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Computes strengths and gaps by comparing current to target role requirements.
